# ScummVM for the ESP32-P4 tablet boards (720x1280 NV3052C RGB panel, used in landscape).
# The board is selected with the ESP Board Manager, see README.md:
#   idf.py bmgr -b p4_rgb1280_nv3052c_v1_2     (or p4_rgb1280_nv3052c, the dev board)
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

include($ENV{IDF_PATH}/tools/cmake/project.cmake)

# Board defaults generated by the Board Manager come after sdkconfig.defaults
set(BMGR_DEFAULTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/components/gen_bmgr_codes/board_manager.defaults")
if(EXISTS "${BMGR_DEFAULTS}")
    list(FIND SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS "${BMGR_DEFAULTS}" BMGR_DEFAULTS_INDEX)
    if(BMGR_DEFAULTS_INDEX EQUAL -1)
        if(SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS)
            list(INSERT SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS 1 "${BMGR_DEFAULTS}")
        else()
            set(SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/sdkconfig.defaults;${BMGR_DEFAULTS}")
        endif()
    endif()
endif()

project(scummvm)
